newsitem.title: USA: Sunglass faces class action suit - lawyers.
newsitem.headline: Sunglass faces class action suit - lawyers.

text.p: A class action lawsuit was filed against Sunglass Hut International Inc and certain officers on behalf of shareholders, alleging violations of U.S. securities law, the plaintiffs' lawyers said on Friday.
The class action suit was filed on behalf of all persons who purchased or otherwise acquired the securities of Sunglass Hut between March 21, 1996 and October 10, 1996, they said.
It was filed in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Florida, the lawyers said.
The company was not immediately available to comment.

According to the complaint, defendants disseminated numerous announcements during the class period concerning Sunglass's alleged financial success and rapidly expanding sales, lawyers said. Defendants also made numerous positive pronouncements concerning the company's distribution systems, marketing efforts and product offerings, lawyers said.

Plaintiffs alleged that these statements made Sunglass's stock price rise and were materially false and misleading because they failed to disclose an alleged series of problems relating to its allegedly expanding inventories, deteriorating sales, and limited product offerings, lawyers said.

The complaint further alleged that, while these alleged problems were concealed from the investing public, certain Sunglass officers and directors sold over $5 million worth of their Sunglass Hut stock holdings at or near its highest price during the class period, lawyers said.

Plaintiffs seek to recover damages on behalf of class members and are represented by, among others, the law firms of Milberg, Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP, Stull, Stull & Brody, Weiss & Yourman and Burt & Pucillo, they said.
